name: Datavidence Financials API
description:
Normalized US-GAAP financial statements and SEC submissions metadata, sourced from SEC EDGAR XBRL filings. Authenticate with the `X-API-Key` header; all errors use a standard `{status, error{code, message}}` envelope.

**Try it without an account:** send `X-API-Key: sandbox_demo_key` to the server below. It returns a fixed sample (`ticker=AAPL`, `year=2023`); other companies or years return a `SANDBOX_LIMITED` error.

**Live data:** subscribe through RapidAPI (plans at https://financials.datavidence.ai/pricing). Subscribers call the same paths through the RapidAPI gateway, `https://datavidence-financials-api.p.rapidapi.com`, with their RapidAPI key in the `X-RapidAPI-Key` header.

Documentation: https://financials.datavidence.ai/docs. This document is published at https://financials.datavidence.ai/openapi.json; a copy found elsewhere may be out of date.
